def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); out=[r[:] for r in g]
    # Extract vertical marker columns in the lower marker area.
    marks=[]
    for x in range(w):
        cells=[(y,g[y][x]) for y in range(h) if g[y][x]]
        if len(cells)>=2 and len({c for _,c in cells})==1 and cells[-1][0]>=h-1:
            marks.append((x,cells[0][1],cells[0][0]))
    # Extend each horizontal object across its zero gaps. Each bar's gaps
    # are filled by its own color; markers extend upward in their columns.
    for y in range(h):
        xs=[x for x in range(w) if g[y][x]]
        if xs:
            # Fill enclosed gaps, and extend a row segment to the full span of
            # that same-color component(s).
            for x in range(min(xs),max(xs)+1):
                if g[y][x]==0:
                    left=next((g[y][z] for z in range(x-1,-1,-1) if g[y][z]),0)
                    right=next((g[y][z] for z in range(x+1,w) if g[y][z]),0)
                    if left and right: out[y][x]=left if left==right else right
    # marker columns are drawn upward until the corresponding horizontal row;
    # stop at the first occupied cell in that column.
    for x,c,start in marks:
        for y in range(start-1,-1,-1):
            if g[y][x]!=0: break
            out[y][x]=c
    return out
PY

def transform(g):
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in g]
    bars = []
    # Complete gaps inside each horizontal bar, using the color on its sides.
    for y in range(h):

        if not xs:
            continue
        bars.append(y)
        for x in range(min(xs), max(xs) + 1):
            if g[y][x] == 0:
                left = next((g[y][z] for z in range(x - 1, -1, -1) if g[y][z]), 0)
                right = next((g[y][z] for z in range(x + 1, w) if g[y][z]), 0)
                if left and right:
                    out[y][x] = left if left == right else right
    # Bottom markers define vertical guide columns. Each horizontal bar
    # colors the segment above it up to the previous bar; its own pixels win.
    markers = []
    for x in range(w):
        ys = [y for y in range(h) if g[y][x]]
        if ys and max(ys) >= h - 2 and len(ys) <= 2:
            markers.append((x, g[ys[0]][x]))
    for x, marker_color in markers:

                upper = bars[i - 1] + 1 if i else 0
